svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The reviewer prompt is rendered by substituting two slots in a template. The template the model catalog serves has only the tenant policy slot, so extra_policy is dropped silently. Pinning Codex's bundled template restores the extra_policy slot, and the SIB rules land after Codex's built-in security policy.
